relations.subject: Amalananda Ghosh
relations.evidence: Ghosh joined the Archaeological Survey of India in 1937 and eventually rose to become its Director-General. He served in that position from 1953 to 1968.

relations.subject: Amalananda Ghosh
relations.evidence: He was a Fellow of the Indian Institute of Advanced Study from 1968 to 1971.
